label: ZFTA::RELA

sections.text: ZFTA encodes a nuclear zinc-finger transcriptional regulator.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 65998 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: RELA encodes p65, a transcriptional subunit of the NF-kappaB complex.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 5970 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: The fusion combines ZFTA chromatin targeting with RELA transcriptional activation. Experimental deletion studies show that the ZFTA zinc-finger and RELA activation regions are required for tumorigenesis, whereas the RELA domain that recruits NF-kappaB complexes is dispensable. It occurs in supratentorial ependymoma.

audit_evidence.location: Results, Figures 6-7; ZFTA-RELA ZF and TAD, but not RHD, are required for tumorigenesis
audit_evidence.scope: ZFTA chromatin targeting and RELA activation required; NF-kappaB recruitment is not itself indispensable.
